summary: Frontend-only regression on rewritten /sobre page. Direct-load renders cleanly with data-testid=sobre-page and all required sections (História, Missão, O Que Nos Diferencia with 6 cards, O Nosso Compromisso with 5 items, Visão, closing 'Obrigado por fazer parte da nossa história' + tagline 'Crafted for Your Game. Built to Perform.'). Two mount/unmount cycles /sobre <-> /produtos via nav-produtos/nav-sobrenos triggered ZERO pageerror events and ZERO 'destroy is not a function' errors. CTA sobre-cta-produtos correctly navigates to /produtos. Regressions verified: /parcerias loads clean, /produtos shows exactly 3 product cards (xoks-pro-elite, xoks-carbon-blue, xoks-stealth-ankle), home hero H1 'Blinda o teu jogo' renders.
critical_code_review_comments: SobreNos.jsx useEffect at line 42 has empty deps array and no cleanup return, so no destroy path exists — consistent with fix holding.
Only useEffect on the page is the safe scrollTo; no subscription/observer patterns to leak.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SobreNos page fully verified after content rewrite. Zero console/page errors on load and across 2 unmount/mount cycles. Regression on /parcerias, /produtos (3 cards with testids product-card-xoks-pro-elite/carbon-blue/stealth-ankle), and home hero also clean.
rca of the issue: N/A — prior 'destroy is not a function' bug remains fixed (useEffect returns nothing, and no cleanup callback is registered).
